name: SacCubing I 2017

venue.name: Sunshine Event Center
venue.address: 9360 Elk Grove Florin Rd, Elk Grove, CA 95624

information: This competition will have a 100 competitor limit for online registration. Registration will be $12+3n, where n is the number of events you will be competing in. As this is the first competition in the Sacramento area, we do not know how popular it will be. We would like everyone to compete, so if online registration ends up filling up, we will update the website with additional instructions.
